svg.text: 4 · a file that cannot be shown says why
never a blank panel, never a stack trace
the near limit badge is one component,
NearLimit, used in all four places
is in the label and in
checked in the browser, from the schema:
a whole number, or a number
at least minimum, at most maximum
errors show once a field is touched,
the server still checks every value
a pattern the browser cannot compile
